width is label/content-driven and source does not define a mobile collapse policy
TabsController uses automatic activation with roving tabindex; consumers own overflow layout
Pill tabs retain 40px geometry independently of underline tabs. Boxed tabs retain 39px geometry independently of underline tabs.

pass: focused rounded-control regressions cover A4, A9 with separate line, shell, and paint assertions as applicable

interactionEvidence.manualStateWalk: pass: pointer hover/click, Tab/Arrow/Home/End, disabled and narrow long-label surfaces inspected

findings.description: Repeated or direct construction could leave competing controllers, initial selection did not exclude native disabled, document-scoped validation rejected detached roots, programmatic activation accepted foreign tabs, and malformed or cross-root ARIA relationships were accepted silently.

Real hover and the static helper diverged, a generic hover contract erased the three source-family paints, active underline/pill paint was source-inaccurate, and disabled foreground/surface/border paint was incomplete across underline, pill and boxed families.
Pill tabs retain 40px geometry independently of underline tabs.
Boxed tabs retain 39px geometry independently of underline tabs.

knownLimitations: overflow, wrapping and responsive navigation policy are consumer-owned
pill and boxed Showcase matrices are static style fixtures without panels
